metadata.description: A hierarchical, incrementally updated knowledge base for coding agents: briefs over repositories, documentation and other sources, kept current as they change.

plugins.name: hrono
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code the hrono map of a project: briefs of everything its sources hold - repositories, documentation, wikis - from one overview down to the files. Passages that match each prompt are attached automatically, every session is told where the map is, and Claude walks it for questions about how the project fits together.
